notes.title: Gold Rush! was one of Sierra's odder adventures, but what made it so strange?
notes.content: From 2010 to 2014 Richard Cobbett wrote Crapshoot, a column about rolling the dice to bring random games back into the light. This week, can an enterprising soul make a fortune, or will the vagaries of adventure gaming in 1988 take their toll?.. Read more.

notes.title: Gold Rush! 2 update to 1.0.3 released for PC!
notes.content:
A first update to version 1.0.3 for Gold Rush! 2, the sequel to Gold Rush! Anniversary, is available on Steam. The update fixes some small issues and adds some texts and voices.

Here is the changelog:
- Minor graphics issues fixed
- Some words was mispronounced in the voices, they was recorded new
- Before the first train-quest, there was a mistake with the text
- The texts for the robbery in the train was changed
- fixed some layer problems
- added small graphics
- fixed small issues
- fixed problems taking the dynamite, climbing the pole and speaking to the officer, on some few resolutions

http://store.steampowered.com/app/609100

notes.title: Gold Rush! 2 was released for PC on Steam today!
notes.content:
Gold Rush! 2, the sequel to Gold Rush!, was released for PC on Steam today. In addition, Sunlight Games has released some more screenshots of the game.
The versions for Mac and Linux will be released soon after the PC-version was released.


http://store.steampowered.com/app/609100

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/qqz6plS.jpg[/img]

Steam Trading Cards are now available for Gold Rush! Classic. 10 cards, 7 backgrounds, and 10 emoticons are in the set. We hope you enjoy them. Thanks for your support.
